test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper earns 25% profit, if he sells an article at 10% discount on the marked price Rs. 2,500. Find his profit.
solution: Given: Discount = 10% Profit = 25% Marked Price = Rs. 2500 Concept used: Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount%)
